name: Full Experiment V1 — Step00: QA continuation on Articles01/04/05
initialization: Exact selected Phase10 QA weights, covering Articles02/03, with original unscaled alpha16 configuration; fresh optimizer.
original_article_exposure: Each V8 parent already received its five complete assigned articles.
template_design: Six formulations each for magnitude, actor, mechanism; six auxiliary own-source questions per article.
loss: Assistant-content and real EOS tokens only; prompt, chat template and padding masked -100.

validation.selection: Minimum token-weighted answer NLL across all15 questions; earliest epoch tie. Epoch0 is retention baseline only.

retention_policy: Measure old02/03 NLL before/after and once-only source-consistency diagnostics. Report deterioration; no automatic replay, added epochs or test-based checkpoint reselection.

parallel_inference.per_instance: Fresh request identity, context, RNG and output path; immutable shared weights.

limitations: Holding out wording does not hold out facts.
Copied adapters are not independently trained replications.
Prior02/03 checks are exploratory retention checks.
Low loss does not prove persistent beliefs or reliable debate behavior.
